props.name: items
props.description: The records in the list pane.

props.name: itemLabel
props.description: The item’s name — the detail pane’s heading, and the back button’s context.

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Content of one row. The row is already a button; do not put controls inside it.

props.name: renderDetail
props.description: The detail pane’s body, under the heading.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected id. Null for nothing selected.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the item the reader opens.

props.name: splitAt
props.description: Container width in pixels from which the panes sit side by side. Below it, one pane shows at a time.

props.name: emptyDetail
props.defaultValue: 'Select an item to see it here.'
props.description: Shown in the detail pane while nothing is selected, side by side only.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Label of the back button on narrow layouts.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the detail title.

props.name: listWidth
props.description: Width of the list pane when side by side, as a CSS length.
